notes: Both coders found almost the same 53 passages. Main disagreements: (1) actor, B often coded research-section duties on 'Investigators' as instructor where A coded all; resolved to all because investigators are researchers. (2) policy_type on the student authorization sentences (P04 vs P06 vs P11) resolved to P04 for 'must be authorized by the course faculty' and P06 for 'must be specifically allowed ... for the given course', and on disclosure/record-keeping and bias units (P27 vs P24, P26 vs P62, P31 vs P62). (3) unit_stance on sanction and training units (restrict vs prohibit, neutral vs require) resolved to restrict or neutral. (4) A coded the instructor analysis-of-student-records rule as UNCOVERED; resolved to P101 with a fit note. (5) The research-committee sentence holds two rules; split into P65 (approval) and P98 (registry). One-sided units: A-only 4 (Tool becomes operational, incorporating cited GAI info, researcher evaluation of AI recommendations, IRB description of inputs leaving UAMS), B-only 3 (purpose statement, clinical-policy handoff, IRB determination); all kept after checking the source. One A unit recoded UNCOVERED because P16 covers code only. The final file has 61 units, one more than the union because of the split.
